payload.title: A weighing arbiter's verdict is never checked against its own side_rulings: an answer whose verdict names a side it ruled evidence_missing or speculative is accepted and recorded as an ai_judge row, and nothing reads the rulings afterwards.
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judgment_bridge.py:231-269 (arbiter_side_rulings checks only that each bound side is ruled once with a member of SIDE_RULINGS; the ruling of the side the verdict names is never compared with the verdict)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judgment_bridge.py:363-364 (validate_judge_response adds only those shape errors for a weighing answer; no verdict-versus-ruling error exists)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judgment_bridge.py:625-627 (the recorded row carries the rulings exactly as the arbiter gave them)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:894-899 (the store re-checks vocabulary membership and request_ids only)
.claude/agents/aria-consensus-arbiter.md:53-56 (contract: the verdict is the upheld side, and an unweighable answer omits the verdict instead of laundering it into one)

aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:1033-1041 (the kernel's ref grades go only into the rendered prompt; the bound arbiter_inputs carry none, so the bridge holds no kernel grade to compare a ruling with)
aria-kernel/tests/test_j3_every_split_weighed.py:251-274 (the refusal tests cover absent, unruled and out-of-vocabulary rulings; no test gives a verdict that contradicts its rulings)
payload.rule_violated: J3 contract: every split is weighed and each side gets a recorded ruling that the verdict follows (aria-consensus-arbiter.md Evidence Weighing Mode: 'the upheld side', 'never launder an unweighable answer into a verdict'); a boundary must enforce the rule it announces.
payload.notes: The arbiter answers verdict true_positive with side_rulings [true_positive: evidence_missing, false_positive: upheld], or rules both sides speculative and still gives a verdict. validate_judge_response returns no error, because arbiter_side_rulings only checks that each bound side is ruled once with a member of SIDE_RULINGS, and record_judge_verdict_from_response writes an ai_judge true_positive row carrying the contradicting rulings, which generate_ai_consensus counts as a vote. The contract rule that the verdict is the upheld side, and that an unweighable answer must omit the verdict, is therefore unenforced at the very gate J3 adds. Nothing reads side_rulings after the write and the kernel's per-ref grades never reach the bridge, so no later step notices either. Close condition: validate_judge_response refuses a weighing answer whose verdict names a side that is not ruled `upheld` (a named reason such as side_rulings:verdict_not_upheld), and test_j3_every_split_weighed.py asserts that verdict true_positive with [true_positive: evidence_missing, false_positive: upheld] is refused with no arbiter row written, while the consistent answer is still recorded. Plan row: J3 (the F0.7 exit). Verified at head 3451f5c3fc of open pull request #2135; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
